auto_resize_images.description: Automatically resize image attachments to provider-friendly limits.

base_url.description: Default base URL for the provider.

max_concurrent_tool_calls.description: Maximum number of independent tool calls to execute at once.

max_retries.description: Number of retries for transient LLM API failures.

mcp_servers.description:
MCP servers whose stdio tools are exposed to the agent. Each map key
identifies a server and becomes part of its qualified tool names.

provider.description:
Credential namespace for the OpenAI-compatible provider (usually
"openai"). Defaults to `"openai"`.

provider_headers.description: Provider-specific headers for the legacy/default provider.

providers.description:
Providers and their models. Models are deliberately nested under a
provider instead of using pi's flat provider/model catalog shape.

session_title.description: Settings for generating a session title from its first user message.

shell.description:
Shell executable used by the bash tool. When unset, the user's SHELL
environment variable (or the platform fallback) is used.

shell_timeout.description:
Default timeout in seconds for the bash tool. Commands that exceed
this duration are killed. Defaults to 60 seconds.

show_thinking.description: Show model thinking/reasoning in user-facing output.

McpAuthSettings.description: Authentication for a remote MCP server.

oneOf.description: Add an API key to every remote MCP request.

api_key.description: API key value sent to the remote server.

header.description: HTTP header receiving the API key. Defaults to `Authorization`.

prefix.description: Optional text prepended to the API key. Defaults to `Bearer `.

McpServerSettings.description:
Configuration for one MCP server.

Set `command` for a local stdio server or `url` for a remote streamable
HTTP server.

args.description: Arguments passed to `command` for a local server.

auth.description: Authentication sent to a remote MCP server. Defaults to no auth.

command.description: Executable used to start a local stdio server.

env.description: Environment variables added to a local server process.

tool_prefix.description:
Optional prefix for discovered tools.

When omitted or empty, the remote tool name is used directly after
sanitization. Configure a prefix to disambiguate tools deliberately.

url.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint for a remote MCP server.

ModelCostRates.description: Model cost rates per million tokens.

cache_read.description: Cost per million cache read tokens.

cache_write.description: Cost per million cache write tokens.

ModelSettings.description:
A model defined under a user provider in `settings.toml`.

Model IDs are map keys rather than fields, which keeps the configuration
grouped by provider and makes it possible to use IDs containing characters
such as `/` when they are quoted in TOML.

api.description:
API variant used by the provider (e.g., OpenAI Chat Completions or
Responses).

base_url.description: Override the base URL for this specific model.

context_window.description: Maximum context window size in tokens.

cost.description:
Optional cost rates per million tokens.

When omitted, usage cost is tracked as zero.

hidden.description: Whether this model is hidden from the interactive model picker.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens the model can output.

reasoning.description: Whether this model supports reasoning/thinking output.

supports_reasoning_effort.description: Whether this model accepts the Responses API `reasoning.effort` option.

ProviderSettings.description: A user-defined provider and the models belonging to it.

api_key.description:
Optional inline key. Prefer the platform keyring or environment
variables for secrets; this is accepted for convenient local setups.

base_url.description:
OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The model's `api` selects Chat
Completions or Responses wire format.

headers.description: Additional HTTP headers to send with every request.

include_usage.description:
Whether streaming requests include usage data in `stream_options`.

When unset, `stream_options` is omitted from requests for this provider.

models.description: Models provided by this provider, keyed by model ID.

SessionTitleGenerationMode.description: Select when a generated session title is requested.

oneOf.description: Generate the title at the same time as the first agent response.
Generate and save the title before the first agent response begins.

SessionTitleSettings.description: Configuration for generating titles from the first user message.

enabled.description: Whether new sessions receive an LLM-generated title.

generation_mode.description: Whether title generation runs alongside or before the first response.

model.description:
Model selector used for title generation. When omitted, the active
conversation model is used.
